reader_summary.headline: Today, in this episode of Behind the Memo, Howard shed some light on themes from his most recent memo.
reader_summary.overview: Today, in this episode of Behind the Memo, Howard shed some light on themes from his most recent memo. Here he is discussing the illusion of knowledge with Oak Tree Senior Financial writer Anna Shamansky. So, Howard, your most recent memo is a discussion of macro forecasting, and you've, for many years expressed your disregard for macro forecasts.
